sources.title: Krookodile ex — Mega Evolution Chaos Rising 55（Strong Bite）
sources.documentVersion: Card text as printed (Limitless card page); cross-checked against the Rainier card database 2026-10-09
sources.supportsZh: “If this Pokémon has a Pokémon Tool attached, this attack does 140 more damage.”：这只宝可梦身上附着着宝可梦道具时追加伤害。BW 年代写法 “If this Pokémon has a Pokémon Tool card attached to it” 意思相同（如 Excadrill bw5 57 Reinforced Drill）。

sources.title: Marowak — Sun & Moon Unbroken Bonds 91/214（Assault Boom）
sources.documentVersion: Official international card database; English card text cross-checked against the Rainier card database 2026-10-09
sources.supportsZh: “If your opponent's Active Pokémon has a Pokémon Tool card attached to it, this attack does 70 more damage.”：读对方战斗宝可梦身上的道具。

dataContractZh: 新条件 HAS_TOOL（只接受 target，单只公开宝可梦）：目标身上附着至少 1 张宝可梦道具即成立。
serverAuthorityZh: 服务器读公开场上的附着道具列表；道具效果被无效化时道具仍附着着，条件照样成立（卡文只问“是否附着”）。
limitations: “每附着 1 张道具造成 N 点”（全场计数）不在本条件内。
